title: OpenChronicle: A self-hosted interaction engine that makes your LLM conversations durable
description:
OpenChronicle is A self-hosted interaction engine that makes your LLM conversations durable. Persistent long-term memory, deterministic tasking, and fully auditable decision trails injected directly into your workflow. Totally provider-agnostic. Plug in any model you want. Seamlessly supports your local CLI, Discord bots, and MCP servers out of the box.

https://github.com/Einsia/OpenChronicle
